exposure: parents' educational status (college degrees and above)
history of previous neonatal NICU admission
cohort: The study included parents of preterm neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in selected governmental hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Parents of preterm infants admitted to the NICU reported high levels of stress, which was significantly associated with factors such as gestational week, parental educational status, mode of admission, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery, specifically cesarean section, was identified as significantly associated with parental stress in the study's conclusion.
cross-section timing: During the preterm infants' admission to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit in 2022.
gest_age: Preterm neonates (implied <37 weeks gestational age), with gestational week between 34-37 weeks specifically identified as an associated factor.
